purpose: offline calibration of modeled tip_r to operator-defined physical claw center/frame

frame_convention.base_axes: x forward/away from robot, y robot-left, z up
frame_convention.physical_claw_center: center used by operator for alignment
frame_convention.physical_claw_axis_base: unit vector from wrist toward fingertips
frame_convention.physical_claw_x_axis_base: unit vector along a marked jaw/reference direction; required only to resolve yaw/full frame

measured_table_light_contact.interpretation: HISTORICAL LEFT-ARM EVIDENCE ONLY: some physical left-claw geometry first touched the table at this joint state; do not use this as a measured tip_r/right-claw floor or tool-frame calibration

forward_rise_measurement.note: this measured 39/61 mm over 383 mm result supersedes the earlier visual estimate of about 10 degrees
forward_rise_measurement.identifiability: clearance is claw-center minus board-surface height; by itself it cannot distinguish claw-path slope from board-plane slope

measurement_protocol: A_REFERENCE: safe hover. Record modeled tip_r pose. Measure physical claw axis in base; also measure a jaw/reference axis if a unique yaw correction is desired. Align physical claw center to a fixed mark used by C and D.

B_FORWARD: keep the same commanded tip quaternion, translate 50-100 mm in +base X, and measure the physical claw-center displacement including height change. Do not use B as a pivot pose. This short local repeat is needed to distinguish a true fixed-frame effect from the older long-span 39/61 mm observation.
C_PIVOT_PITCH: return the physical claw center to the exact A mark, change orientation about one horizontal axis by roughly 8-12 deg, and record modeled tip_r pose.
D_PIVOT_ROLL: keep the physical claw center on the same A mark, change orientation about a second nonparallel horizontal axis by roughly 8-12 deg, and record modeled tip_r pose.
